mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially leading to levetiracetam accumulation since levetiracetam is primarily renally eliminated; both drugs may have additive neurotoxic effects.
action: Monitor renal function and levetiracetam levels; adjust levetiracetam dosing if creatinine clearance declines during tobramycin therapy; assess for signs of neurotoxicity.
